path_1_official_catalog.documented_flow: ExecutionProviderCatalog.find_all_providers() -> find AMDGPUExecutionProvider -> ensure_ready_async() -> register the returned library_path with ORT

observed.ensure_ready_reason: ensure_ready is an instance method on a provider returned by find_all_providers(); with zero providers there is no object to address, so no download/install was attempted

path_1_official_catalog.conclusion: the catalog does not list AMDGPUExecutionProvider on any surface, so the official dynamic-install path cannot be started
